reviews.title: Gpu on a budget that is great
reviews.comment: Great power supply, well worth the money, I have bought 3 of these in the last year and function great. It is very quiet and no compatability issues what so ever. Love the modular cables, it keeps things clean. I recommend this psu it is well worth it.
reviews.author: Rich Hardman

reviews.title: Great power supply for the money
reviews.comment: Works great in my mid-level PC gaming build!
reviews.author: Tcbrianw

reviews.title: Great 600W PSU for under $55
reviews.comment: I had not used a Zalman PSU prior but I will keep this PSU in mind for future builds needing 600W of power. I could barely even hear the psu fan as the cpu fan is usually loudest. I built a Ryzen 5600G build with the Zalman 600W with intentions for adding in a GPU. A 600W should support most mid range gpus like the RX 6600 and RTX 2060.
reviews.author: Evan

reviews.title: Great for basic to midlevel systems, no 6-pin ePCI GPU connector
reviews.comment: This Power Supply Unit (PSU) is of great value if your graphics card does not require a 6-pin ePCI GPU connector. Other than the lack of this style of power connector, I am pleased with the quality of the power supply and recommend it for basic to midlevel systems.
reviews.author: Georgia Moir

reviews.title: Not modular, but has all the connections that I needed
reviews.comment: I thought that I was ordering a modular power supply. ( My mistake) We have an older computer and all the connections fit. Power-wise it is 700 watts and it handles everything that I throw at it.
